typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	FileName as string (),
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string (),
	userName as string ()
}

source(output(
		{Serial num} as decimal(18,0),
		{Site Location} as string,
		Day as date,
		{Max Record Temp } as float,
		{Incidents beyond Max allowed Temp} as float,
		{Min Record Temp } as float,
		{Incidents beyond Min allowedTemp} as float,
		{Total Incidents beyond Threshold Temp} as float,
		{Max Record RH } as float,
		IncidentsbeyondMaxallowedRH as float,
		{Minimum Record RH } as float,
		IncidentsbeyondMinallowedRH as float,
		{Total Incidents beyond Threshold RH} as float
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(FName = $FileName,
		UploadDate = currentTimestamp(),
		EtlUser = $userName) ~> DerivedColumn
FlatFileSource aggregate(groupBy(),
	rowcount = count(1)) ~> RowCount0
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		IncbeyondMinallowedRH as double,
		UploadDate as string,
		MaxRecordTemp as double,
		MaxRecordRH as double,
		SiteLocation as string,
		FName as string,
		SerialNum as integer,
		EtlUser as string,
		TotalIncbeyondThresholdTemp as double,
		IncbeyondMinallowedTemp as double,
		IncbeyondMaxallowedRH as double,
		TotalIncbeyondThresholdRH as double,
		IncbeyondMaxallowedTemp as double,
		Day as string,
		MinRecordTemp as double,
		MinimumRecordRH as double
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		IncbeyondMinallowedRH = IncidentsbeyondMinallowedRH,
		UploadDate,
		MaxRecordTemp = {Max Record Temp },
		MaxRecordRH = {Max Record RH },
		SiteLocation = {Site Location},
		FName,
		SerialNum = {Serial num},
		EtlUser,
		TotalIncbeyondThresholdTemp = {Total Incidents beyond Threshold Temp},
		IncbeyondMinallowedTemp = {Incidents beyond Min allowedTemp},
		IncbeyondMaxallowedRH = IncidentsbeyondMaxallowedRH,
		TotalIncbeyondThresholdRH = {Total Incidents beyond Threshold RH},
		IncbeyondMaxallowedTemp = {Incidents beyond Max allowed Temp},
		Day,
		MinRecordTemp = {Min Record Temp },
		MinimumRecordRH = {Minimum Record RH }),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
RowCount0 sink(validateSchema: false,
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	store: 'cache',
	format: 'inline',
	output: true,
	saveOrder: 1) ~> RowCountCACHESINK
